purpose: Teach: 和田/小野/阿部/内田/西村/太田/前田/永田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新体制、和田部長と小野課長、営業の二枚看板。
lines.en: New structure: Director Wada and Section Chief Ono as the twin pillars of sales.
lines.style: Even, measured announcement. Brief pause after the colon — organizational clarity matters. Each name lands with equal weight. No flourish, no hesitation. The voice of someone stating facts that have already been decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。阿部さん、内田さんは、サポート役で固めます。
lines.en: Yes. Abe and Uchida will anchor the support side.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Methodical, as if checking off a list he's already internalized. Professional courtesy to his superior — responsive but not deferential. Slight focus on the word 'anchor.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 西村さん、太田さんは、海外拠点へ。
lines.en: Nishimura and Ota — they're heading to the overseas offices.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact delivery. A small beat before the dash — he's moving to the next assignment without drama. The tone of someone distributing important news without needing to perform the importance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 前田さん、永田さんは、研修担当として残します。
lines.en: Maeda and Nagata stay on as training leads.
lines.style: Clear and even. The word 'stay' carries slight emphasis — continuity matters. Still methodical, still responsive. No apology in the voice, just precision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Crisp close. The word 'notify' is efficient, final. A breath that settles the meeting. Hiroshi speaks like someone who knows his words have weight, so he doesn't need to add pressure.
